ExportCampaign followed by ImportCampaign into a new directory reproduces the campaign's scenes/tokens at export time; the original working campaign remains untouched and openable afterward

ImportCampaign into an already-existing, non-empty target directory returns PersistenceExportImportFailed and leaves the pre-existing content untouched -- no automatic merge is attempted
a .odcamp archive with a path-traversal entry (../escaped.txt) is rejected with PersistenceExportImportFailed before any entry is extracted; nothing is written outside the extraction directory
a .odcamp with a structurally-valid-JSON but semantically invalid manifest.json (missing required fields) is rejected with PersistenceManifestInvalid, not a raw exception

importing a .odcamp whose manifest.json declares an unsupported DatabaseSchemaVersion returns PersistenceExportImportFailed; no migration is attempted

the roadmap section 10.5 nine-step SLICE-01 scenario (create campaign, import one test map, create a scene, place two tokens, move them, close, reopen, verify saved state, restore from backup) runs end-to-end in one reproducible test using only already-merged ODY-S01-007..012 APIs, with every step asserted

SqliteGameLogRepository.SaveDiceRollEntry persists a DiceRoll and its GameLogEntry in one ADR-012 section 5 transaction; a brand-new repository instance against the same campaign.db (simulated process restart) restores an identical roll (NaturalResults, ModifierEntries, BaseTotal/FinalTotal, Status, Audience.Kind) and log entry, with a real AuthoritativeSequence (ADR-012 section 4.1 EventSequence) assigned, never left at its pre-commit placeholder

SaveDiceRollEntry redelivered with the same CommandId replays the stored GameLogEntryRecord (same LogEntryId) instead of creating a duplicate row -- AppliedCommands idempotency (ADR-012 section 7.2) applied to the new DiceRolls/GameLogEntries aggregate pair

the roadmap section 12.6 ten-step scenario (player selects own token via control ownership; sends a roll intent; host validates permission; host generates a formula result via real RNG; modifiers are applied; GM overrides with a mandatory reason; only permitted participants receive the result under a nontrivial SelectedParticipants audience, with safe denial for an excluded participant; the event is persisted via real SQLite; a reopened repository restores the visible journal recomputed by CURRENT, not saved, group membership; after a full reroll the original event's own NaturalResults/FormulaOriginal/persisted row remain unchanged) runs end-to-end in one reproducible test using only already-merged ODY-S03-004..007 public APIs, with every step asserted and zero new production code
BoardGeometry.EuclideanDistance computes the ADR-020 GridType=None default formula correctly against hand-computed values (3-4-5 triangle, same-point zero distance)
BoardGeometry.IsFinite rejects NaN and Infinity on either axis and accepts ordinary finite values
BoardGeometry.AlmostEqual/SamePosition correctly classify a value just inside GeometryEpsilonV1 as equal and just outside as not equal, on both axes independently
BoardMovementService.MoveToken by the token's controller succeeds and advances the token's authoritative revision by one

BoardMovementService.UndoMoveToken restores the token's previous position as a new compensating command (revision 3 after create-at-1/move-at-2), not a rollback to the original revision

A valid move on a Public entity broadcasts a TokenMovedDelta to two independently connected clients (Player and Observer), both converging on the same position and revision, over real InProcessSessionTransport delivery
An invalid move request (not the requester's own token), submitted over real InProcessSessionTransport, is rejected with a typed failure and triggers no delta broadcast to any connection
